input_shape: [N, 1] string tensor, one raw SMS/notification string per row
note: output[1] gives per-class probabilities; scam is class label 1

training_data.real_source: UCI SMS Spam Collection (5,574 human-written SMS)
training_data.synthetic_purpose: India/UPI-specific patterns absent from the UCI corpus
training_data.eval_note: metrics measured on held-out REAL messages only
